reason: Zahir Insight - PSAK 109 Laporan Arus Kas: semua baris jurnal (approved) dari transaksi yang menyentuh akun kas/bank tertentu (filter account_id), untuk memilah arus kas menurut akun lawan
name: psak109_kas_lawan
query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.* FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      g.id            AS transaction_id,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code          AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      jv.project_id
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
tx AS (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
SELECT
  jv.id                                  AS jurnal_id,
  jv.transaction_id,
  g.tanggal::date                        AS tanggal,
  g.nojurnal                             AS referensi,
  k.code                                 AS kode_akun,
  k.nama                                 AS nama_akun,
  k2.noklasifikasi,
  COALESCE(jv.debit, 0)::numeric(18,2)   AS debit,
  COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0)::numeric(18,2)  AS kredit
FROM tx
JOIN g_jurnal g  ON g.id = tx.transaction_id
JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = tx.transaction_id
JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
JOIN subklas s   ON s.id = k.subclassification_id
JOIN klas k2     ON k2.id = s.classification_id
ORDER BY g.tanggal, jv.transaction_id, jv.id {andOrder} {limit}
query_count:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.* FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      g.id            AS transaction_id,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code          AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      jv.project_id
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
tx AS (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM tx
JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = tx.transaction_id
